resources.string: Follow one action at a time. Record missing results and continue.
Complete this action before continuing. Record a missing result if blocked; it is not a pass.
Guide finished · %1$d missing steps. Evidence is in Logs; upload manually.
Park before testing and confirm the vehicle and connection. Connect CarPlay for phone tests; disconnect it for media / navigation samples. Opening this guide does not start a test.
Tap the highlighted Start listening control. Test one physical button at a time within two minutes; release it and wait for the label dialog.

Test previous / next, play / pause, short / long voice presses, and volume up / down. Label each received input with the actual button. Repeat as needed; tap No input received if nothing arrives. Use physical buttons.
Tap End / Stop and wait for the stopped state. Check sound, playback and the vehicle display. A stop request does not prove resource release.

After completing or recording missing steps, open Logs and upload manually. Describe the vehicle model, connection method, action order and observed behavior. Omit passwords, device identities and spoken content.
Grant microphone permission, tap Start test and speak toward the car microphone. Watch the level; stop or wait ten seconds. A normal level proves local input, not Siri recognition.
Request Siri and record the result

Keep a real CarPlay connection and stop local recording before requesting Siri. Say a simple command; observe the phone and car, then choose Responded or Missing / abnormal. Record missing if no phone is available.
Tap Start reporting and confirm. Wait for the current fixed test sample. An API return does not prove display on the vehicle media card, cluster or HUD.
Compare Current sample with the vehicle display, then choose Visible or Missing / abnormal. Change each field and observe again. Each changed sample needs a new judgment.
End reporting and wait for local cleanup. Check whether the sample disappeared from the vehicle display, then choose Cleared or Residual / abnormal.
Disconnect the phone, choose a sample and decoder path, then run the current case. Watch for motion, black frames, corruption or stalls. A software result does not prove vehicle hardware support.

Wait for the case to finish and check its result. Surface output requires your picture judgment. Buffer output has no picture; failures and skipped cases can continue to logs. Repeat each path separately to record each judgment.

Tap Collect checks and wait for the task dialog. Read specific failure reasons; stop from the dialog if needed. The report describes environment facts, not a successful phone connection or vehicle display.
Step through USB, hotspot, video, audio / calls and Bluetooth handoff
Connect the iPhone cable and start wired CarPlay. Observe connection, prompts and crashes. Keep the cable still and return to record the initial connection result.
Enable the hotspot in Android native settings. Keep iPhone Wi-Fi and Bluetooth on; start wireless CarPlay. Observe hotspot, discovery and projection. Return and record the initial wireless result.
Observe CarPlay video, record black frames, stalls or normal playback. Test returning from Settings in the next step. Record the fault before restarting.
Play music, trigger a navigation prompt, then test a call and Siri. Record sound location, gaps and music recovery after each action. Judge stock Bluetooth music by actual listening.

Connect the target phone to stock Bluetooth while CarPlay is projecting. Play music and observe sound first; test buttons and calls in later steps. Record source conflicts or silence on the phone and vehicle.

Test only Previous / left. Press once and release (hold for a long press), wait for the label dialog and choose the actual physical key. Observe the phone and vehicle response, then choose Expected behavior observed or Missing / abnormal. If no input arrives, tap No input received to record this step as missing.

Test only Next / right. Press once and release (hold for a long press), wait for the label dialog and choose the actual physical key. Observe the phone and vehicle response, then choose Expected behavior observed or Missing / abnormal. If no input arrives, tap No input received to record this step as missing.

Test only Play / pause. Press once and release (hold for a long press), wait for the label dialog and choose the actual physical key. Observe the phone and vehicle response, then choose Expected behavior observed or Missing / abnormal. If no input arrives, tap No input received to record this step as missing.

Test only Short voice press. Press once and release (hold for a long press), wait for the label dialog and choose the actual physical key. Observe the phone and vehicle response, then choose Expected behavior observed or Missing / abnormal. If no input arrives, tap No input received to record this step as missing.

Test only Long voice press. Press once and release (hold for a long press), wait for the label dialog and choose the actual physical key. Observe the phone and vehicle response, then choose Expected behavior observed or Missing / abnormal. If no input arrives, tap No input received to record this step as missing.

Test only Volume up. Press once and release (hold for a long press), wait for the label dialog and choose the actual physical key. Observe the phone and vehicle response, then choose Expected behavior observed or Missing / abnormal. If no input arrives, tap No input received to record this step as missing.

Test only Volume down. Press once and release (hold for a long press), wait for the label dialog and choose the actual physical key. Observe the phone and vehicle response, then choose Expected behavior observed or Missing / abnormal. If no input arrives, tap No input received to record this step as missing.
Record the first connection result, unplug the cable and observe disconnection. Reconnect and start the same connection; check recovery, stalls or crashes. Return here to record the result.

Record the first wireless result. Keep the same hotspot configuration, disconnect and reconnect; observe discovery, negotiation and picture recovery. Return and record the result without changing passwords or modes.
Enter Settings from projection, then return. Observe recovery or a stuck picture; record the result after switching. Record before trying manual recovery.
Play phone music for ten seconds. Record sound, its location and any gaps. Record before triggering a call or Siri.
While music plays, trigger one phone navigation prompt. Record its sound location, music ducking and recovery afterward. Omit locations and road names.
Place or receive a call and check audio and the microphone. Hang up, wait ten seconds and record music recovery. Omit numbers, contacts and call content.
Request Siri with a simple command. After it ends, check music recovery, route changes or silence. Return and record the result; use the guided voice test for recognition issues.
Use physical steering buttons for play / pause and track changes. Observe the vehicle, phone and actual music sound. Record behavior here; use the steering guide for detailed input evidence.

Tap only the highlighted action for this step and wait for Current sample to update. Compare it with the vehicle display, then choose Visible or Missing / abnormal before continuing. Each change needs its own judgment.
